blocks.html: The principles focus on object-oriented design, but their concepts can be adapted to other paradigms.
blocks.text: The principles focus on object-oriented design, but their concepts can be adapted to other paradigms.

blocks.html: They are not rules to be applied blindly — they require judgment and understanding of the problem domain.
blocks.text: They are not rules to be applied blindly — they require judgment and understanding of the problem domain.

blocks.html: The SOLID principles work together and sometimes overlap in scope. They are not completely separate from each other. Applying just one in isolation may still lead to design issues if the others are ignored.
blocks.text: The SOLID principles work together and sometimes overlap in scope. They are not completely separate from each other. Applying just one in isolation may still lead to design issues if the others are ignored.

blocks.html: There is no strict, universally defined rule or step-by-step checklist to check or prove SOLID compliance in a software.
blocks.text: There is no strict, universally defined rule or step-by-step checklist to check or prove SOLID compliance in a software.

blocks.html: It’s judgment-based, guided by a clear understanding of responsibilities and relationships in your specific domain.
blocks.text: It’s judgment-based, guided by a clear understanding of responsibilities and relationships in your specific domain.

blocks.html: Each section gives general guidelines, shown as rules, to help apply the principles and notice violations. Some rules may seem repetitive, but that’s on purpose to make things clearer and easier to grasp.
